items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Harry told me that himself. ... But you didn’t know Harry when he was still in Boston. ... I think. That’s what I heard, anyhow. But he lived around the same – not too far – not too many streets away from where we had lived.

ctx.x: Harry Carney’s father, yes. Harry told me that himself.
But you didn’t know Harry when he was still in Boston.
